name: max-game
description: Max's Overworld - a browser overworld game

scripts.build: node scripts/refresh-web-assets.mjs && npm run generate:dialogues && npm run check:dialogues && npm run generate:profiles && npm run generate:dialogue-themes && npm run generate:battle-avatars && npm run generate:bookshop-npcs && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run bundle
scripts.bundle: node scripts/refresh-web-assets.mjs && npm run clean:dist && esbuild js/main.ts js/internal.ts js/niall-fight.ts js/transform.ts --bundle --minify --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name]-bundle --format=iife && node scripts/stamp-web-entrypoints.mjs
scripts.watch: node scripts/refresh-web-assets.mjs && npm run generate:dialogues && npm run generate:profiles && npm run generate:dialogue-themes && npm run clean:dist && esbuild js/main.ts js/internal.ts js/niall-fight.ts js/transform.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name]-bundle --format=iife --watch
